summary: Cartesian Growth Corp III, a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of a $150,000 unsecured promissory note to its sponsor, CGC III Sponsor LLC. The note is non-interest bearing, payable upon the earlier of an initial business combination or winding up. The sponsor may convert principal into working capital warrants on identical terms to IPO private placement warrants, subject to transfer restrictions. This filing is a SPAC working capital loan, providing bridge financing before a de-SPAC transaction. Watch for the target announcement and shareholder vote; the conversion feature aligns sponsor incentives with deal completion.
